method: One independent fixture is the resampling unit. Team rows, frames, decisions, episodes and reflected orientations are not independent samples. Fixed heterogeneous strata are descriptive, not league estimates. 4000 deterministic paired fixture bootstrap draws give exploratory uncertainty; small n and fixed designs limit generalisation. First outcomes and final outcomes may differ for one canonical shot ID. A generated/executable option and a model credible category are separate; neither is calibrated real-world xG.
